# baffinbay_ip_lists (Data Source)

Retrieves all Baffin Bay IP Lists for the configured tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_ip_lists" "all" {}

output "ip_lists" {
  value = data.baffinbay_ip_lists.all.ip_lists
}
```
